id: 21_Chemical safety Safety measures in microbiology labs laboratory safety microbiol
title: 微生物实验室安全措施：化学品安全
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/21_Chemical safety Safety measures in microbiology labs laboratory safety microbiol.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/21_Chemical safety Safety measures in microbiology labs laboratory safety microbiol/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在化学品柜前，柜门上有危险化学品象形图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a chemical storage cabinet with hazard pictograms on its door and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 微生物实验室，也有不少化学品。
overlay: 微生物实验室安全措施：化学品安全

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现标签、柜子、通风柜、泄漏包四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to four floating icons: a label, a cabinet, a chemical fume hood and a spill kit bucket.
shots.narration: 今天讲标签储存、操作和泄漏。

shots.scene: 实验台上摆着消毒液、染色液、固定液和乙醇瓶
shots.prompt_en: Bottles of disinfectant, staining solution, fixative and ethanol on a microbiology bench, each with a hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 消毒液、染液、固定液、乙醇……

shots.scene: 阿杰在开放台面上倒固定液，皱起眉头闻到气味
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pours a fixative on an open bench without goggles and wrinkles his nose at the smell.
shots.narration: 阿杰在台面上倒固定液，气味很冲。

shots.scene: 小研快步过来，指向通风柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over and points toward a chemical fume hood.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧叫停：换个地方，戴好防护。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 化学品安全，从一张标签说起。

shots.scene: 一排试剂瓶，每瓶都有带象形图的标签
shots.prompt_en: A row of reagent bottles, each with a clear label showing a hazard pictogram and blank lines. No people.
shots.narration: 所有化学品和试剂，都要清楚贴标签。

shots.scene: 一个没有标签的瓶子被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A bottle of clear liquid with no label, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 看不出是什么的瓶子，最危险。

shots.scene: 小研把模糊脱落的标签换成新的
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student replaces a faded, peeling label on a bottle with a fresh one.
shots.narration: 标签模糊、脱落，要及时补上。

shots.scene: 化学品柜分成几格，各有象形图
shots.prompt_en: A chemical storage cabinet divided into separate compartments, each marked with a different hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 储存时要看化学品的相容性。

shots.scene: 火焰象形图的瓶子与圆圈火焰象形图的瓶子被隔开
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with a flame pictogram and a bottle with a flame-over-circle pictogram are separated by a divider. No people.
shots.narration: 不相容的化学品，要分开放；

shots.scene: 老周对照说明书检查柜内摆放
shots.prompt_en: The older man checks the arrangement inside the cabinet against a data sheet.
shots.narration: 按照安全指南来摆放。

shots.scene: 小研在化学通风柜里倒固定液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours a fixative inside a chemical fume hood, wearing goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 挥发性或有毒的化学品，

shots.scene: 通风柜气流箭头把蒸气带走
shots.prompt_en: Airflow arrows inside a chemical fume hood carry vapor up and away from the operator area. No people.
shots.narration: 要放进化学通风柜里操作。

shots.scene: 开放台面上冒出蒸气的瓶子被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A bottle releasing vapor on an open bench, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 别在开放台面上倒，别凑近闻。

shots.scene: 手套和护目镜图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: Icons of chemical-resistant gloves and safety goggles light up. No people.
shots.narration: 穿戴合适的个人防护装备，

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上护目镜和手套，扣好实验服
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles and gloves and buttons up his lab coat.
shots.narration: 比如手套和护目用品。

shots.scene: 墙边放着泄漏处理包，旁边有标识
shots.prompt_en: A spill kit bucket stands by the wall near the lab entrance, easy to reach. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室要备好泄漏处理包，

shots.scene: 泄漏包打开，里面有吸附材料、手套、袋子、小铲
shots.prompt_en: An open spill kit showing absorbent pads, gloves, sealable bags and a small scoop. No people.
shots.narration: 吸附材料、防护用品、收集袋都在里面，

shots.scene: 泄漏包前堆着纸箱被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Boxes piled in front of a spill kit, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 放在显眼处，不被杂物挡住。

shots.scene: 王老师给学生们演示泄漏包的使用
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator demonstrates a spill kit to a small group of students including the young male student.
shots.narration: 怎么清理泄漏，要事先培训。

shots.scene: 学生们轮流练习，阿杰认真看
shots.prompt_en: Students take turns practising with the spill kit while the young male student watches closely.
shots.narration: 每个人都要学会正确的清理程序。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在化学品柜和通风柜之间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a chemical storage cabinet and a chemical fume hood.
shots.narration: 一起回顾一下。

shots.scene: 标签和分格柜图标
shots.prompt_en: A label icon and a compartmented cabinet icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶瓶贴标签，按相容性分开存。

shots.scene: 通风柜、手套、护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a chemical fume hood, gloves and goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 挥发有毒进通风柜，防护戴好。

shots.scene: 泄漏包和培训图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a spill kit and a training class. No people.
shots.narration: 泄漏包常备，清理先培训。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在通风柜前挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye in front of a chemical fume hood.
shots.narration: 化学品用得对，实验才安心，下次见！
